question: In which of the following states was the first edition of the Khelo India University Games held in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khelo India University Game** is a **national multisport competition** in which athletes compete in a variety of sports from Indian universities.
 
• The** first edition**, which took place in **Odisha**, began **from February 22, 2020, to March 1, 2020**.
 
• Along with the National Sports Federation, Indian Olympic Association, Association of Indian Universities, and **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, it is organized by the** Sports Authority of India (SAI).**
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** opened the** inaugural Khelo India University Games** in **Cuttack** on February 22, 2020.
 
• The Khelo India University Games are a significant step towards developing a strong sports culture in India and nurturing young talent for international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian government came up with the idea of **Khelo India**, which means** "Let us play India," in 2017** in an effort to resurrect the country's athletic heritage through grassroots involvement with kids.
 
• The Prime Minister recently heralded in a new era for Indian sports by virtually inaugurating the **third edition of the Khelo India University Games (KIUG) in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**.The **state animal of Uttar Pradesh, the Swamp Deer (Barasingha)**, is represented by **Jitu,** the **mascot of the third edition of the Khelo India University Games**.
 
• **Assam** hosted the **third edition of the Khelo India Youth Games in January 2020**, but has not yet hosted the Khelo India University Games.
